Academy award-winners have walked the steps we are now humbly taking. From the Big Apple to the Mini Apple - STRUNG is going STRONG. 
 
Judges of the highly regarded @bigapplefilmfestival have credits from Warner Bros, NBC Universal, and Netflix. Names like Shia LaBeouf, Jesse Eisenberg, and Alan Cumming have competed in previous years. Cross your fingers as we await any nominations and awards, and keep them crossed while we compete in the renowned @mspfilmsociety . We were just informed that we were selected into the Final 13 Short Fiction Films AND has been included in their Best of Fest screening. What an honor. 
 
Outside of the Big and Little Apple we have Los Angeles eyes on us as we compete in the @believepsychologyfilmfest under their Resiliency & Hope Category. We should find out about nominations and awards very soon. 
 
Outside of the US, @piff.festival is in love with STRUNG. Again - keep crossing those fingers as we patiently await nominations and awards for the leading International Festival in Prague.

Last month in Los Angeles we had the honor of being a finalist at the @flicks4change festival - where our Wyatt was given a nomination for Best Supporting Actor. Thank you F4C. As filmmakers, we always want our films to make a difference- make a change - and Flicks4Change can attest that this film has, and will continue to inspire change. 4est Films 4U. 4est Films 4Change.
 
Finally, and not surprisingly, back in the Big Apple - Wyatt snagged yet another Best New Actor award in NY last month. This time from @nycindieshortsawards . This kid is a star. This movie is magic. Your support is everything. Thank you for your love.

🎭After months of isolation - we finally came together to premiere our award-winning film. In our celebration, we raised nearly $15,000 for @emilyshope_ and @tallgrassrecovery to aid those facing addiction that are unable to afford treatment, and to eradicate the stigma behind the disease. 

🌹We at 4est Films give massive thanks to the Sioux Falls State Theatre for providing a safe & stunning space - to @angiekennecke for creating such a powerful foundation in her daughters name, and for hosting this two day event - to @ashleyvthompson for showcasing us on your @keloland News : @kelolandliving show 💛

🏕Though the subject matter of our film is dense, you can see in these amazing photos by @jakephotographysf that there was no shortage of joy. Thank you for capturing this event so beautifully, @tyjacobsen We can always count on you 🤩

🙏Our gratitude for all of those who attended is beyond measure. We plan to bring @strungfilm back to Sioux Falls to show at other venues. Before we come back - we are thrilled to announce we will be bringing Strung to Chicago and Minneapolis - and if the cards continue to fall - possibly Phoenix, Boston & more.

If you haven’t seen this film - let us know where you are so we can come to a theatre near you! ♥️

🌹You’re Invited🌹

We are honored to premiere Strung at the historic 1920s renovated Sioux Falls State Theatre. 

✨Thanks to our sponsors Avera McKennan Hospital and First Premier Bank & Premier Bank Card, your ticket to the event is free with a donation to South Dakota’s Tallgrass Recovery & Sober Living Homes and/or Emily’s Hope Foundation. 

🎟Follow the link in our bio or go to 4estfilms.com to claim your ticket

Who is he!? He’s a star on the rise. He’s Wyatt Darling, and he just won Best Young Actor @lafilmawards - making this his 4th acting award in just one month! 

If we haven’t told you already - this was his first film he had ever acted in. Can you believe that? I guess with an amazing actor father in @jeromydarling and invincibly supportive mother in @gretchendarling - it’s pretty natural for the kid to be honest with his feelings and actions. 

If you swipe right you will see behind the scenes - just one of the many moments of the pure joy and childlike exploration he brought into the rehearsal space @conduitsound just days before we were about to shoot in the forest. If you swipe again you’ll see his official award - and one more swipe will bring you to the incredible accolade of Honorable Mention for First Time Directors in @bezzfeed and @ryanhreid4 making this their second directing award.

✨🌿Competing in a pool of film submissions from over 30 countries, we are proud to announce our star Wyatt Darling won the Gold Award for Best Child Actor @independentshortsawards for his performance in @strungfilm 💛

🎖A winning weekend in LA 🎖
Wyatt (9 y/o) took home “Best Child Actor” AND “Best Supporting Actor” - which means he beat adult performances in feature films for this category. On top of this - @jeromydarling received “Best Actor in a Drama” to compliment his prestigious- “Best Performance of Fest” award. Thank you @actorsawards 4 so much to celebrate. ♥️ Thank you - all of you - who have been supporting this film. Inspire others to join our journey... we have only just begun. 💫💐😊
Our star, @jeromydarling - just won the most prestigious award at the @actorsawards ⭐️🍾 Pinch and zoom to read about his immaculate performance - wow - we are humbled by the eloquent words. 💐

Actors Awards Los Angeles officially selected both of our actors from @strungfilm !@jeromydarling for Best Actor in a Drama, AND his son, Wyatt Darling, for Best Child Actor. We are so proud. More to come! ⭐️

A social media caption for the wrap of your first film is next to impossible to write.

Having said that, Day 9 was a skeleton crew as most of our crew was sent home to get them back in time for Thanksgiving. Our DP, @aaronjberger, got to go back to his roots of Guerrilla-style shooting and the weather did NOT disappoint. Clear skies, 60 degrees, the Missouri River, a horse named “Hollywood” and a dilapidated farmhouse all came in clutch for us as we got EVERY shot we needed for this film. 

We truly feel indebted to this amazing crew and the town of Tabor for being a part of this and for making it such a pleasant and magical experience. 

Never could we have dared to dream of anything resembling the last 10 days. There simply isn’t a way, in this life, to thank people for the gift we were given in time, talent, and territory. Now we just have to edit the movie - a MASSIVE undertaking in and of itself. 

Say a prayer for us and spread the word. God bless you all 🙏🏼

One look at the Day 8 call sheet, and it was near impossible to even wrap our heads around the reality of completing all our scenes today.

But somehow, by the grace of God, we got through all of them 🙏🏼

At one point even having to split our team in two and send part of our already skeleton crew to a different location to shoot one of our scenes.

Send a prayer for us as we gear up for our final day tomorrow and completely wrap up the shooting of this film!

Day 7 was a doozy - it started off with prayer and ended full of kids! So much energy and joy and focus. We learned a lot from them and soaked up all the cuteness as best we could. So grateful to all the parents who showed up - rarely ever have we been around a group of more well-behaved children. Their energy was infectious. 

We have only TWO days left and this film shoot will wrap! It's hard to get our heads around that, so say a prayer for us and spread the word.

We have been so blessed to have all these amazing little actors gracing our set again today!

Creating this film up to this point has had alot of heavy scenes and heavy moments. 

And today we have all gotten to tap into the play and innocence of our own inner children with these kids around 🙏🏼.

God bless them ❤️

Day 6 was so wild that I thought it was day 7. So I’ll start with that. We went from the most precious children imaginable, spitting verses and jokes in a historically kept 1890 classroom to a demonic presence haunting our main characters in a barn. 

Our director shed tears for the first time on set… We are truly confident that what we are creating is a masterpiece. Every single person on this project is dedicated to producing their best work. We are pushing boundaries and experiencing cathartic breakthroughs. I believe today’s profundity is largely due in part to the precious presence of children’s imagination and innocense. 

We’re still a little behind in schedule so we are continuing to clip at a rapid rate - please pray that we can capture all that this motion picture requires

Day 5 is officially in the books with one very talented young actor wrapped. Hats off to Zelalem! 

After 4 days of intense emotional scenes, day 5 was all about adorable scenes and adorable people. 

We are clearly in a groove, with even a sporadic dance party bursting out at one point during the day. 

Now we are prepping for a whole bunch of kids tomorrow, and it’s a good thing, as there are 20 of them! And the very talented Kurt Larson in his big screen debut.

Onto Day 6!

Today we have some new cast members on set! Introducing Sister Mary Catherine and Gregory!

The tone of the film has definitely shifted with these two present, and we are enjoying the levity and novelty of these new characters!

We are still making a push to get some more scenes done, and will do our best to check in again at the end of the day 🙏🏼

Day 4 was powerful beyond words. This first image filled with beauty (light) and pain (blood) does a better job of describing the feeling of the day than I ever could. 

Day 4 was the most difficult to date - and the most rewarding.

We are midway through Day 4, and our Director @bezzbunny enters the scene as The King of Virginia City, bringing some flair and quite an ambiguous character into the mix for @hnimfilm!

We still have quite a push to make our scenes, so back to the grind and we will check up again at the end of the day!

Day 3 was our biggest challenge yet. From massive wind, to drilling happening just feet away from our shooting location, to finding out our piano is going to be a half key off of correct pitch, to having to ask our team to go into overtime grace period - today we were forced to make adjustments, find solutions, and work late into the night. 

And yet - we captured some of the most magnificent moments I have ever had the pleasure of being a part of on any movie set. The talent on this team is continuing to surprise and inspire. 

Once again - we’re left with nothing but gratitude and beautiful motion pictures. 

Cheers to the toughest and most rewarding day yet. A massive applause to the entire HNIM team. ♥️

Day 3 is well underway and the team is firing on all cylinders, as everyone is once again stepping in to wear many hats and contribute to the overall vision!

We still have alot of shooting to get us to where we want to be at the end of the day so we are diving right back in!

End of day check-in to follow soon 🙏🏼

By the power of God we were able to capture every shot on the day 2 schedule! We took every minute of another 12 hour day, but we did it! I couldn’t be more proud and grateful for the hard work that came from our team today. 

As you know - we only got 40% of yesterday’s schedule shot - so we were very concerned we were going to dig ourselves even deeper into schedule trouble today if we didn’t pick up our speed. Concern no more - we were on track today - and my hope and prayer is we will get ahead of schedule tomorrow so that we can pickup what we missed from yesterday. 

Send your prayers because we don’t have the ability to add another day to our schedule - we must get ahead and pickup what we missed from Day 1. 

Wow. Another day of miracles. Another day of team feeling like family. Another day of magic in Tabor, SD. Sometimes when you make movies - only a few people on the project seem to care and have passion for the story… on this set - I have found care and passion from every single individual. . . And for that - I have infinite gratitude..

Thank you Day 2.

We are midway through Day 2!

Once again the team has shown up to put all hands on deck to make this magical film a reality. 

More to shoot and coordinate, so we are diving back in, but we will update more at the end of the day!

Until then enjoy these images!

Day 1 of HNIM is wrapped. More surprising acts of providence than we could have dreamed were revealed today. Truly miraculous moments. 

We only shot 40% of what we had scheduled, but we tackled the most difficult part of the script - technically, emotionally, and otherwise. It’s also the opening moments of the film - so it was vital we did it right. The shots are exceptional and the performances are honest and captivating. However, our biggest challenge now will be to catch back up and finish this film by the 22nd. 

Our team is already a family. This is truly one of the greatest pockets of time I have yet experienced as a creative. My gratitude for the people on this set goes beyond words. The town of Tabor has joined hands and hearts to make this movie possible. 

I could go on and on - but I believe these stunning shots taken by our BTS Doc Filmmaker @ryanmcboyle paint a beautiful montage of moments from this incredibly special day.
